s1.syndrome_frame: A middle-aged woman with a long-standing breast lump and axillary discomfort
salient_findings: Mobile lump in the right breast
Migratory discomfort and pain in the right axilla and upper-outer quadrant
Multiple hypoechoic masses on breast ultrasonography
key_facts: 58-year-old woman
3-year history of a right-breast lump
No family history of breast cancer
Menopausal for 5 years
Drank impure water
Mobile lump palpated in the right breast
Breast ultrasonography revealed multiple hypoechoic masses
No obvious blood-flow signals detected within the lesions on color Doppler flow imaging

salient_findings: Mobile lump in the right breast
Migratory discomfort and pain in the right axilla and upper-outer quadrant
Multiple hypoechoic masses on breast ultrasonography
key_facts: 58-year-old woman

Drank impure water

No obvious blood-flow signals detected within the lesions on color Doppler flow imaging

differentials: Pseudoangiomatous stromal hyperplasia with giant cells
Primary breast lymphoma with amyloid deposits
Langerhans cell histiocytosis of the breast
Mast cell disease of the breast
per_call: Pseudoangiomatous stromal hyperplasia with giant cells
Primary breast lymphoma with amyloid deposits
Langerhans cell histiocytosis of the breast
Mast cell disease of the breast

shortlist.label: Invasive ductal carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Most common type of breast cancer, consistent with patient's age and presentation

shortlist.label: Fibroadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Common benign breast tumor, could explain mobile lump and ultrasonography findings

shortlist.label: Phyllodes tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Rare tumor that can present as a mobile lump, ultrasonography findings consistent with this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Ductal carcinoma in situ
shortlist.why_kept: Pre-invasive cancer that can present with similar ultrasonography findings

shortlist.label: Invasive lobular carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Second most common type of breast cancer, could explain patient's symptoms and ultrasonography findings

raw.rationale: The presence of a mobile lump, multiple hypoechoic masses with well-delineated contours on ultrasonography, and the absence of obvious blood-flow signals within the lesions are consistent with fibroadenoma, a common benign breast tumor.

rejected.label: Invasive ductal carcinoma
rejected.why: Invasive ductal carcinoma typically presents with irregular, spiculated masses and increased vascularity, which is not consistent with the ultrasonography findings in this case.

rejected.label: Phyllodes tumor
rejected.why: Phyllodes tumors are typically larger and more rapidly growing than the masses described in this case, and may have a more heterogeneous appearance on ultrasonography.

rejected.label: Ductal carcinoma in situ
rejected.why: Ductal carcinoma in situ is a non-invasive cancer that typically does not form palpable masses, and is often detected by mammography or ultrasonography as microcalcifications or small, non-mass lesions.

rejected.label: Invasive lobular carcinoma
rejected.why: Invasive lobular carcinoma often presents with a more subtle, infiltrative appearance on ultrasonography, and may not form distinct, well-circumscribed masses like those described in this case.
